description: Wastewater levels for COVID-19, flu and RSV at every CDC sewershed site that serves a county: each site's level and category for the latest week, the readings for the last weeks (default 6, up to 12) and the population served. If no site serves the county, lists the counties in the state that have one.

county.description: County name, e.g. "Cook", "Los Angeles County", "St. Louis" or "Orleans Parish".

pathogen.description: covid (SARS-CoV-2), flu (influenza A), rsv, or all. Default all.

weeks.description: Weeks of history per site. Default 6.

name: covid_flu_rsv_levels_county
title: COVID, flu and RSV wastewater levels in a county
